BrochureContent.Content:
Tucked away in the peaceful and picturesque enclave of Dungriffin Villas, The Cottage offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of both worlds, a rural setting with spectacular panoramic views, all within walking distance of Howth village.

Dungriffin Villas is one of Howth’s hidden gems , a discreet cul-de-sac, home to just a handful of properties. It enjoys an idyllic setting bordered by greenery and connected via a charming pedestrian boreen that links directly to the heart of the village. The location offers a unique sense of privacy and tranquillity while remaining close to all essential amenities.

Dating from the 1980s, this detached cottage occupies a private, elevated site with off-street parking to the front and a neatly maintained, mature rear garden. Thanks to its position, the property enjoys sweeping views over Howth village and out toward Dublin’s skyline. Facing west, it also benefits from stunning evening light and unforgettable sunsets, perfect to enjoy from the comfort of favourite chair.

The accommodation is well laid out and filled with natural light. It extends to a generously proportioned 106m2 or 1,144 square feet and comprises an entrance porch, living room, sitting room, a galley kitchen/breakfast room, three bedrooms (main bedroom ensuite), and a family bathroom. Gas-fired central heating provides a cosy atmosphere throughout, making it a welcoming and comfortable home year-round.

Whether you're downsizing, searching for a peaceful retreat, or seeking a charming home with views and character, this property offers an exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of Dublin’s most desirable coastal locations.

Viewing is highly recommended and available by appointment.
